privacy: Static library; no student writing or analytics
guidance: Suggestions must be weighted by relevant signals and student choice, with uncertainty preserved. No student text leaves the device.

lenses.name: Ecocriticism
lenses.question: How does a story portray relationships between people and environments?
lenses.studentChoice: Explore, revise, combine, or set aside this lens; it is a possibility, not a diagnosis.
lenses.definition: Studies how stories and cultural language shape our relationships with environments.

lenses.name: Environmental justice
lenses.question: Who experiences environmental benefits and harms?
lenses.studentChoice: Explore, revise, combine, or set aside this lens; it is a possibility, not a diagnosis.
lenses.definition: Asks who bears environmental harms and who has a voice in decisions.

lenses.studentChoice: Explore, revise, combine, or set aside this lens; it is a possibility, not a diagnosis.
lenses.definition: Considers the worth of living beings beyond their usefulness to people.
